blurb: Guests fish aboard a 31' Pursuit boat with a crew that provides all tackle, bait, rod/reel, and ice. Trips range from inshore to offshore fishing targeting various species including Red Snapper, Wahoo, Tuna, Mahi Mahi, Amberjack, Kingfish, and Spanish Mackerel. Fishing licenses are covered by the crew; guests bring food, drinks, and sun protection.
